{{Top|leg}}
The '''Minister of Notification''' was a position in the [[Cartann]] government on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. When a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Death/Legends|fell]] in combat, in training or in a duel, the Minister was in charge of sending notifications to the families and all appropriate parties. One such minister was [[Uliaff ke Unthos]].<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
